[LHYD.10.4.1] **Series skip hydrated facts by default.** The series
runtime ignores updates for facts of a hydration target whose `corr` is
non-empty ([LHYD.4.1.7]). This stops a 24_h retrospective hydration
from polluting a 10_min-window live-data series with a burst
of replayed historical values.
